methodology.ats: Team win/loss/push is derived from the verified game ATS winner. Favorite spreads are stored from the favorite perspective as negative numbers.
methodology.totals: The game Over/Under result is applied equally to both participating teams.
methodology.analysis: Team pages distinguish verified game and market facts from interpretive commentary.
methodology.unavailable_policy: Use a verified closing market when explicitly available. Otherwise, grade against the latest stored verified pregame snapshot and label it as such; never relabel that snapshot as closing.
